body:
Avery R: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need three clear owners and concrete deadlines for (1) a 1-2 line statuspage update, (2) a plain-language customer incident summary, and (3) the gate/process for sharing full RCAs.
Tom K: I can do the statuspage note + short summary draft. Keeping statuspage to 2 lines. ETA: tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
Priya S: Support will generate the affected-account export and tag SLA customers. ETA: today 16:00 UTC. Will mark high/medium/low.
Hector M: Ops ask: publish the short status note immediately for transparency, then publish the sanitized summary after legal review?
Legal Team: Confirmed. Short status note okay to post now. Full RCA or anything with customer identifiers/raw logs requires review and a signed DSA. We'll provide a redaction checklist and a "how to request more" template.
Avery R: Action items summarized: Tom -> statuspage + summary draft by 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Priya -> affected list + SLA flags by 16:00 today. Legal -> redaction checklist + template by EOD tomorrow.
Tom K: I'll include a "how to request more details" paragraph linking to support and call out DSA requirement. Avoid internal IDs or commit hashes in the public text.
Priya S: For outreach cadence: SLA customers get a direct email within 24h of summary sign-off; all affected customers see the sanitized summary via statuspage and ticket within 48h.
Hector M: Recommend adding a recurring 48h follow-up: product + legal reconvene to decide if the public summary needs an update once mitigations land.
Legal Team: Good idea. We'll add that to the checklist and supply follow-up language samples.
support-bot: Incident INC-2026-410 status changed to "postmortem_pending" by @avery at 2026-03-29T10:02:12Z.
Avery R: I'll log these owners/times in the incident action tracker and run a short check-in on Wednesday. Ping here when drafts are up for quick review. Thanks all. :pray:
